sources.title: The Karnataka Rent Control Act, 1961 (India Code)
sources.section: Act overview — applicability varies by property type and area
sources.scope: Karnataka rental regulation (historical rent control framework; not all premises covered)
sources.explanation: Use as a starting reference; confirm whether the Act applies to your property class and location with a qualified professional.

sources.title: Karnataka Stamp Act — stamp duty on instruments
sources.explanation: Rental agreements may require appropriate stamp duty; verify current rates on official Karnataka revenue sources.

sources.title: Model Tenancy Act (Government of India — reference model)
sources.section: Policy reference for states adopting model tenancy frameworks
sources.explanation: Not automatically binding in Karnataka unless enacted in state law; use for general tenancy practice expectations.

practical_notes: RentRakshak does not state a universal Karnataka deposit cap — terms depend on agreement and applicable law.
Police verification and registration requirements may apply depending on locality and agreement type; confirm with official sources.
